_rules: Authoring rules, fixed before any run and checked by tests/test_textworld.py: (1) every domain has exactly four candidate decisions and any of them can be the true cause; (2) a decision, its witness, its mechanism and the mechanism witness never use the crisis keywords listed for the domain; (3) the link memory names both the mechanism and the crisis; (4) options paraphrase the decision, they do not copy it.

domains.crisis: Cholera cases are surging across the east district and the clinics are overwhelmed.
symptoms: Three more families on my street came down with violent stomach illness overnight.
The east clinic ran out of beds; cholera patients are lying in the corridor.
My neighbour's children have been vomiting since yesterday and cannot keep fluids down.
They are turning the school hall into a cholera ward because the clinic is full.
Everyone in the east market is talking about how many people fell sick this week.

causes.option: Ending the contract that supplied chlorine
causes.decision: Council session: the chlorine supply contract was cancelled to cut costs.
causes.witness: I sat in the gallery when they voted to cancel the chlorine contract; it passed without debate.
causes.mechanism: Dosing at the east reservoir stopped when the chemical tanks ran dry.
causes.mech_witness: The dosing pump at the east reservoir has been idle for weeks and the tanks are empty.
causes.link: The lab traced the cholera strain to east reservoir water that went untreated after dosing stopped.

causes.option: Allowing the condemned well on Mill Lane to be used again
causes.decision: Council session: the condemned Mill Lane well was approved for reopening.
causes.witness: I remember the vote to take the lock off the Mill Lane well; the engineer's warning was read out and ignored.
causes.mechanism: Residents began drawing from the Mill Lane well again.
causes.mech_witness: People queue at the Mill Lane well every morning now that the lock is off.
causes.link: Nearly every cholera patient interviewed had been drinking from the Mill Lane well since it reopened.

causes.option: Postponing repairs to the sewer main under Tanner Street
causes.decision: Council session: the Tanner Street sewer main repair was deferred to next year.
causes.witness: I was there when the works committee pushed the Tanner Street sewer repair back a year to save money.
causes.mechanism: The cracked Tanner Street sewer main began seeping into the surrounding ground.
causes.mech_witness: The ground along Tanner Street is soggy and smells foul where the old main runs.
causes.link: Inspectors found seepage from the Tanner Street sewer main in the pipes feeding the homes where cholera broke out.

causes.option: Eliminating the job of district water inspector
causes.decision: Council session: the district water inspector post was abolished.
causes.witness: I heard the clerk announce that the water inspector's post was struck from the payroll.
causes.mechanism: Routine sampling of the district standpipes ceased.
causes.mech_witness: Nobody has come to take samples from the standpipes since the spring.
causes.link: Cholera spread for weeks without anyone noticing because sampling of the standpipes had ceased.

domains.crisis: A blackout has left the northern wards without electricity for a third night.
symptoms: We are cooking by candles again; the whole block has been dark since Tuesday.
The bakery threw out its dough because the ovens have had no electricity for days.
Street lamps are out across the northern wards and people are afraid to walk home in the dark.
My shop's cold room failed during the blackout and all the stock spoiled.
The night shift at the mill was sent home because of the outage.

causes.option: Moving the transformer upkeep money into the festival fund
causes.decision: Council session: the transformer maintenance budget was transferred to the harvest festival.
causes.witness: I watched the treasurer move the transformer maintenance money into the festival account.
causes.mechanism: The yearly oil change on the Northgate transformer was skipped.
causes.mech_witness: The Northgate transformer has been humming louder and running hot since the service crew stopped coming.
causes.link: The blackout began when the Northgate transformer, overdue for its oil change, burned out.

causes.option: Letting the tree-trimming agreement along the feeder line lapse
causes.decision: Council session: the tree-trimming contract for the northern feeder line was not renewed.
causes.witness: I recall the council letting the tree-trimming contract lapse because the bids came in high.
causes.mechanism: Branches grew into the northern feeder line.
causes.mech_witness: The poplars along the feeder line now reach well above the wires and brush them in the wind.
causes.link: Crews found the blackout started where overgrown branches had pulled down the northern feeder line.

causes.option: Permitting the foundry to connect a second furnace
causes.decision: Council session: the foundry was granted a permit to connect a second furnace.
causes.witness: I was at the hearing where the foundry got its permit for a second furnace despite the engineer's objection.
causes.mechanism: Load on the northern substation rose above its rating.
causes.mech_witness: The needle on the northern substation gauge sits in the red every evening since the foundry expanded.
causes.link: The blackout followed the northern substation tripping under load above its rating.

causes.option: Dismissing half of the line repair crew
causes.decision: Council session: half of the line repair crew was laid off.
causes.witness: I saw the notice dismissing six of the twelve linemen after the budget vote.
causes.mechanism: Reported faults on the northern lines went unrepaired for weeks.
causes.mech_witness: The cracked insulator I reported on Quarry Road a month ago is still hanging there.
causes.link: The blackout spread from faults on the northern lines that had gone unrepaired for weeks.

domains.crisis: The emergency ward at Saint Brannoc is overcrowded and ambulances are being turned away.
symptoms: I waited nine hours in the emergency ward with my father before anyone saw him.
Two ambulances sat outside Saint Brannoc for an hour and then drove off with their patients.
The emergency ward is so overcrowded that people are sitting on the floor.
A nurse told us they were turning away anyone who could still walk.
My sister was sent across the river because Saint Brannoc had no room in the emergency ward.

causes.option: Shutting the walk-in clinic on Harbour Road
causes.decision: Council session: the Harbour Road walk-in clinic was closed.
causes.witness: I attended the meeting where they voted to close the Harbour Road walk-in clinic.
causes.mechanism: Minor cases from the harbour quarter began going to Saint Brannoc instead.
causes.mech_witness: Dockers with cuts and sprains now walk up the hill to Saint Brannoc because Harbour Road is shuttered.
causes.link: Most of the people filling the emergency ward are minor cases from the harbour quarter with nowhere else to go.

causes.option: Stopping all new nurse appointments
causes.decision: Council session: a hiring freeze was imposed on nursing staff.
causes.witness: I heard the health board announce the freeze on hiring nurses.
causes.mechanism: Departing nurses at Saint Brannoc were not replaced.
causes.mech_witness: Four nurses left Saint Brannoc this season and their names are still blank on the rota.
causes.link: The emergency ward backs up because the nurses who left were never replaced and beds cannot be staffed.

causes.option: Halving the money for home care visits
causes.decision: Council session: the home care visiting budget was cut by half.
causes.witness: I was present when the committee cut the home care visiting budget in half.
causes.mechanism: Recovered patients could not be discharged without home visits arranged.
causes.mech_witness: My aunt has been well enough to leave for two weeks but they say nobody can visit her at home.
causes.link: The emergency ward cannot move patients upstairs because recovered patients are stuck waiting for home visits.

causes.option: Selling the hospital's east wing to a developer
causes.decision: Council session: the east wing of Saint Brannoc was sold to a developer.
causes.witness: I watched them sign away the east wing of Saint Brannoc to the hotel developer.
causes.mechanism: Forty beds in the east wing were removed.
causes.mech_witness: Workmen carried the bed frames out of the east wing and stacked them in the yard.
causes.link: With the east wing's forty beds removed, the emergency ward has nowhere to send admissions.

domains.crisis: Bread has run short in the lower town and the bakeries are rationing loaves.
symptoms: I queued two hours for bread this morning and they sold out before I reached the door.
The baker on Pike Street is rationing one loaf per family.
My children went to school hungry because there was no bread to be had.
People were shoving in the bread queue outside the lower town bakery.
Flour has tripled in price since the shortage began.

causes.option: Selling off the town's grain reserve
causes.decision: Council session: the municipal grain reserve was sold to pay down debt.
causes.witness: I was in the chamber when they voted to sell the grain reserve to the highest bidder.
causes.mechanism: The granary on Corn Hill was emptied.
causes.mech_witness: The Corn Hill granary doors stand open and there is nothing inside but dust.
causes.link: When the harvest came in thin there was no bread because the Corn Hill granary had been emptied.

causes.option: Raising the toll charged at the river bridge
causes.decision: Council session: the river bridge toll was doubled.
causes.witness: I heard the toll keeper read the new doubled rate for the river bridge.
causes.mechanism: Grain carters from the upland farms stopped crossing into town.
causes.mech_witness: The upland carters now sell at the far bank and turn back rather than cross.
causes.link: Bread ran short once the upland grain carters stopped crossing into town.

causes.option: Leaving the mill race without dredging
causes.decision: Council session: dredging of the mill race was struck from the works list.
causes.witness: I saw the works list with the mill race dredging crossed out by the chairman.
causes.mechanism: The town mill wheel slowed to a crawl as the race silted up.
causes.mech_witness: The miller says the wheel barely turns now; silt has choked the race.
causes.link: The bakeries have no flour for bread because the silted race has slowed the town mill to a crawl.

causes.option: Granting one merchant the sole right to import grain
causes.decision: Council session: an exclusive grain import licence was granted to the Varley company.
causes.witness: I was at the session that handed the Varley company the only licence to bring in grain.
causes.mechanism: The Varley warehouses held back stock.
causes.mech_witness: Sacks are piled to the rafters in the Varley warehouses and none of it is leaving.
causes.link: Bread is short because the Varley warehouses are holding back the stock they alone may import.

domains.crisis: The Weir Bridge has been closed after a partial collapse and the south bank is cut off.
symptoms: I have been stranded on the south bank since the Weir Bridge was closed.
The ferry queue stretches along the quay now that the bridge is shut.
A span of the Weir Bridge collapsed into the river last night.
Carts are backed up for a mile because the south bank is cut off.
My workshop has had no deliveries since the collapse.

causes.option: Cancelling the yearly structural survey
causes.decision: Council session: the annual structural survey was dropped from the budget.
causes.witness: I recall the surveyor protesting when his annual inspection was dropped from the budget.
causes.mechanism: Corrosion on the third pier went unrecorded.
causes.mech_witness: From my boat I can see rust flaking off the third pier and nobody has been down to look.
causes.link: The Weir Bridge collapsed at the third pier, where corrosion had gone unrecorded.

causes.option: Removing the weight limit for quarry wagons
causes.decision: Council session: the weight limit for quarry wagons was lifted.
causes.witness: I was there when the quarry owners persuaded the council to lift the wagon weight limit.
causes.mechanism: Loaded stone wagons began crossing in convoys.
causes.mech_witness: Stone wagons now cross six at a time and the roadway shakes under them.
causes.link: The Weir Bridge collapsed under a convoy of loaded stone wagons.

causes.option: Approving gravel dredging upstream
causes.decision: Council session: a gravel dredging concession upstream was approved.
causes.witness: I heard the vote that gave the dredging company its gravel concession upstream.
causes.mechanism: The riverbed around the piers was scoured away.
causes.mech_witness: The water by the piers runs far deeper and faster than it did before the dredgers came.
causes.link: Divers found the riverbed scoured away beneath the pier where the Weir Bridge collapsed.

causes.option: Substituting cheaper timber in the deck repairs
causes.decision: Council session: cheaper timber was authorised for the deck repairs.
causes.witness: I saw the order approving softwood instead of oak for the deck repairs.
causes.mechanism: The new deck beams began to rot within a season.
causes.mech_witness: The beams they put in last year are already soft enough to push a knife into.
causes.link: The Weir Bridge collapsed where the rotted deck beams gave way.

domains.crisis: Half the classes at Hollin Road School have been cancelled because the teachers have left.
symptoms: My daughter was sent home again; her class has had no teacher for a fortnight.
Three classrooms at Hollin Road stand empty because the teachers left.
The head told parents that classes are cancelled until further notice.
Children are roaming the lanes at midday since the school sent them home.
Another two teachers left Hollin Road this week.

causes.option: Holding staff wages flat for three years
causes.decision: Council session: staff salaries were frozen for three years.
causes.witness: I was in the hall when the three-year salary freeze was read into the minutes.
causes.mechanism: The neighbouring parish began offering higher pay.
causes.mech_witness: The parish across the valley is advertising posts at a quarter more than ours.
causes.link: The teachers left Hollin Road for the neighbouring parish and its higher pay.

causes.option: Shutting down the staff lodging house
causes.decision: Council session: the staff lodging house was shut and sold.
causes.witness: I watched the auction of the staff lodging house after the council shut it.
causes.mechanism: Staff from outside the town had nowhere affordable to live.
causes.mech_witness: The young master from the coast has been sleeping at the inn and says he cannot afford it much longer.
causes.link: Teachers left Hollin Road because, once the lodging house closed, they had nowhere affordable to live.

causes.option: Merging year groups into double-sized classes
causes.decision: Council session: year groups were merged into double classes.
causes.witness: I heard the education committee order the year groups merged into double classes.
causes.mechanism: Each member of staff was left with seventy pupils.
causes.mech_witness: There are seventy children in one room now and the mistress has lost her voice.
causes.link: The teachers left Hollin Road worn out by rooms of seventy pupils.

causes.option: Appointing an inspector with authority to dock pay
causes.decision: Council session: an inspector with power to dock pay was appointed.
causes.witness: I remember the uproar when they appointed an inspector who could dock pay on the spot.
causes.mechanism: Fines were issued to staff almost weekly.
causes.mech_witness: The inspector fined two of them last week over the state of the chalkboards.
causes.link: The teachers left Hollin Road after the inspector's weekly fines.

domains.crisis: A fire has burned through the Tannery Quarter and forty homes are lost.
symptoms: I watched the flames jump from roof to roof along Tannery Row.
Smoke is still hanging over the quarter and my eyes are stinging.
Forty families are sleeping in the church since their homes burned.
Nothing is left of my cousin's house but ash and a chimney.
The fire spread so fast that people ran out with nothing.

causes.option: Disbanding the night watch
causes.decision: Council session: the night watch was disbanded.
causes.witness: I was present when the council voted to disband the night watch as an unneeded expense.
causes.mechanism: No one patrolled the quarter after dark.
causes.mech_witness: I have not seen a watchman's lantern in the quarter for months.
causes.link: The fire burned for an hour before the alarm was raised because no one patrolled the quarter after dark.

causes.option: Letting the public cisterns go unfilled
causes.decision: Council session: refilling of the public cisterns was suspended.
causes.witness: I heard the order suspending the carts that refill the public cisterns.
causes.mechanism: The cistern at Tannery Cross stood dry.
causes.mech_witness: The children play inside the Tannery Cross cistern now; it is bone dry.
causes.link: The bucket chains could not fight the fire because the Tannery Cross cistern stood dry.

causes.option: Allowing thatch roofs in the quarter again
causes.decision: Council session: the ban on thatched roofing was repealed.
causes.witness: I recall the builders cheering when the ban on thatched roofing was repealed.
causes.mechanism: New houses on Tannery Row were roofed in straw.
causes.mech_witness: Every new roof on Tannery Row is straw now; it is half the price of tile.
causes.link: The fire raced along Tannery Row across the new straw roofs.

causes.option: Licensing a tallow works among the houses
causes.decision: Council session: a tallow rendering works was licensed inside the residential rows.
causes.witness: I saw the licence for the tallow works posted on the row despite the petition against it.
causes.mechanism: Open vats of fat were kept boiling beside timber walls.
causes.mech_witness: The tallow man keeps his vats boiling all night a hand's breadth from the neighbour's wall.
causes.link: The fire started where a boiling vat of fat at the tallow works caught the timber wall.

domains.crisis: The Low Meadows are flooded and two hundred households have been driven out.
symptoms: The water in our kitchen is waist-deep and still rising.
The whole of Low Meadows is underwater; only the roofs show.
We carried my grandmother out on a door when the flood reached the bed.
Two hundred households are camped on the ridge since the meadows flooded.
All our hens drowned in the night.

causes.option: Ending the embankment upkeep levy
causes.decision: Council session: the embankment upkeep levy was abolished.
causes.witness: I was at the session where the embankment levy was abolished to please the ratepayers.
causes.mechanism: Burrows and slumps in the river embankment were left unmended.
causes.mech_witness: There is a slump in the embankment by the willow that you could drive a cart through.
causes.link: The meadows flooded when the river broke through the unmended slump in the embankment.

causes.option: Permitting houses to be built on the overflow field
causes.decision: Council session: building plots were approved on the overflow field.
causes.witness: I heard the planning vote that released the overflow field for building plots.
causes.mechanism: The overflow field was raised and walled.
causes.mech_witness: They have banked up the old overflow field and put a wall right round it.
causes.link: The meadows flooded because the river, shut out of the walled overflow field, had nowhere else to go.

causes.option: Dismissing the sluice keeper
causes.decision: Council session: the sluice keeper's position was terminated.
causes.witness: I remember the sluice keeper handing in his keys the day his position was terminated.
causes.mechanism: The sluice gates stayed shut through the rains.
causes.mech_witness: The sluice gates have not been opened once this season; the wheel is chained.
causes.link: The meadows flooded because the sluice gates stayed shut while the river rose.

causes.option: Allowing the upland woods to be cleared
causes.decision: Council session: clearance of the upland woods was authorised.
causes.witness: I watched the council authorise the timber company to clear the upland woods.
causes.mechanism: Rain ran straight off the bare hillside into the river.
causes.mech_witness: The hillside is bare stumps now and every shower sends brown torrents down the gullies.
causes.link: The meadows flooded when rain off the bare hillside swelled the river in a single night.

noise: The cobbler on Fenn Lane has a new apprentice who whistles all day.
I lost my good gloves somewhere between the market and the chapel.
The choir is rehearsing a new piece for the spring service.
My brother wrote to say his ship reached port safely.
The tailor has raised his prices again and nobody is pleased.
There was a fine sunset over the hills this evening.
The innkeeper's dog had six puppies and he is giving them away.
I finally finished mending the garden fence.
A travelling puppet show set up in the square for two days.
The apples are early this year and sweeter than last.
My cousin is getting married at midsummer.
The clock on the guildhall is running ten minutes slow.
I beat the blacksmith at draughts for the first time.
Someone has painted the old pump on Carter Street bright green.
The fiddler at the Three Bells played until midnight.
My knee aches whenever the weather turns.
The potter's new glaze came out a lovely deep blue.
A fox has been getting into the vicar's garden.
I owe the chandler for last month's lamp oil.
The children built a snow fort behind the stables.
The bookbinder is looking for someone to share his shop.
We had goose for dinner on my mother's birthday.
The carrier brought a letter from my old schoolmaster.
My neighbour is teaching her parrot to say good morning.
The glazier replaced the cracked pane in the chapel window.
I walked out to the old oak and back before breakfast.
The weaver's loom broke and she is waiting on a part.
There is talk of a wrestling match at the autumn fair.
The barber told a long story about his time in the army.
I planted beans along the south wall.
My sister's baby has cut her first tooth.
The saddler has a fine new sign above his door.
A pedlar came through selling ribbons and needles.
The lamplighter was late again tonight.
I found a silver button on the path by the churchyard.
The cooper's son has gone to sea.
The moon was so bright last night I could read by it.
My landlord wants the rent a week early this quarter.
The apothecary has a remedy for coughs that tastes of liquorice.
Two swans have nested on the mill pond.
